The cause is skill_gap:
1. The agent successfully read all files (results say (ok))
2. The output was truncated because the files are large (standard REPL behavior, mentioned in the instructions)
3. The instructions explicitly say "A cut output names its full copy, e.g. OUT(12): read it in pages"
4. Instead of using OUT() to read the full content, the agent gave up claiming "inability to access the necessary files"
5. The task is clearly defined and solvable
6. No edits were made

The solution_correct is false because no requirements were implemented.

No factory defect to report - the agent simply lacked the skill/understanding to handle truncated output.
